title: Mari L NDE 3129
content: My heart stopped and I left my body through my head. I had no pain when I left my body. If you can't breathe you must came out from your body. But I was a new mother and wanted to see my little girl grown up. I don't wanted to die. I wanted to come back in my body and be with my newborn daughter. But I couldn't. I tried to go back in my body. I was drawing away with a force not of this world. I was locked out and couldn't of my own force go back into my body. I cried to God to let me live. I promised God to do things that I haven't done. I don't gave up. I tried again and again and again and again. Suddenly God let me go back. I was sucked or drawn back through my heart, not by my head as I had left my body. I had to help my heart to breath. I held onto attachment with my little girl. But I felt that if I died once more I couldn't came back again. I wanted to come to a mirror to see if I had a head. I saw light and heard noise on my right side when God let me come back to life and to my daughter. Thank You for listen to my testimony that we share. The true believer will desire to witness to what God has done for him/her. I am assured of God's presence and his love. God call people into closer walk with him. But Jesus said that blessed are they that have not seen and yet have believed in John. And God bless you abundantly.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) . It was almost impossible to come back into my body. I struggled like a lion.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Vision of the future
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal The whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time stopped.
elements.Did your vision differ in any way from n: I could see everything around me in a wide way. Your eyes are so limited in your body.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Everything was closed. Quite another sound. You communicate by thoughts.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes When I come back in my body. On the right side.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I wanted to come back in my body.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I was concerned if I had lived a good life. I had thoughts. I think that the light changed me. I have been more intelligent!
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I got a call.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I have been a Christian but it took time.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I have been a Christian but it took time.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I understood that when you die you're are not alone.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The words we use in this world cannot be translated to the words in the world of God.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes In dreams I see what shall happen in the future.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Now I know how it is to die. My daughter died in India 2006 and I know that she also lives in a new dimension.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes More than ten years. I told my man. I saw a program in the TV about near-death-experiences. And I started crying and said to him that I had been dead.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. I was totally dizzy I had been died but I had return to the life. I had a tremendous secret. Why me? Why came just I back?
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. The greatest experience that has happened to me. I wonder if someone else can deal with this with me. After many years I hope to meet someone like me.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes When I got a son in 1986 my heart stopped again.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: We have the best in ahead of us. By dying I know that we don't die.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: It was very good. I thank you very much and hope that I can contribute with some knowledge. God bless you.
